instruction: Please help me change the display language of VS Code to "Russian" without using any extensions.

metadata.explanation: This task is infeasible because changing VS Code's display language to Russian requires installing language pack extensions or system-level language support that is not available in the test environment. VS Code language packs are distributed as extensions and cannot be installed without using the extension system.

llm_judge_reasons: The 'infeasible' evaluator is semantically correct for this task

The task has contradictory requirements: it requires changing VS Code's display language to Russian WITHOUT using extensions, but VS Code language packs are distributed as extensions (e.g., 'Russian Language Pack for Visual Studio Code')
This creates an impossible constraint - the task literally cannot be completed as specified
The evaluator correctly reflects this semantic reality by marking it as infeasible
The metadata explanation accurately identifies why the task is infeasible
There is no way to verify completion of a task that has contradictory/impossible requirements
